snippet.title: Spell Wizard | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Unleash powerful magic with your keyboard in this Typing Survivor-like. Battle relentless waves of enemies by typing the words tethered to them to cast spells. Collect gems to master new abilities and grow stronger each run.
Wishlist now! - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3389700/Spell_Wizard/?utm_source=yt
